execution.ref: VALIDATOR-09 slice 1, branch claude/validator-09-score-variants. Canonical: score-variant tests and both unreachability invariants passed; the results are recorded in the PR.
execution.description: Development score variants are registered before they are computed and re-scored from stored per-case tuning rows, with a [0, 1] transform where 1 is best, and no miner surface can reach them.

expected: Score development could be a data registry plus a pure re-scorer over stored rows, kept out of every miner surface.
observed: It could, because battery's rows already carry per-case components. The registry had to live outside carbon/challenge_validator, which is itself a walked miner surface, so the Challenge declares its components as data only.
keep: Register a weighting before computing it; re-score from stored rows instead of retraining.
Prove a development-only module is unreachable with both the static import walk and a fresh-interpreter import of every door.
change: Store per-case components with every score, so later weightings never need a re-run.
protocol_elements: every Challenge's score development registers candidate weightings before computing them and keeps them unreachable from miners
